note: Grades and caveats are documented in docs/data-sources.md. Read that before writing a loader - several files are not what their name suggests.

sources.title: Bengaluru streetlights - Bellandur & HSR Layout
sources.note: Per-lamp Point placemarks. Names are OSM node IDs - this is an OSM export of non-functional lamps. Held-out test set, not training data.

sources.title: Bengaluru streetlights - Silk Board to Marathahalli (ORR)
sources.note: Per-lamp points along the ORR corridor. Strongest candidate demo bbox.

sources.title: Vasanthanagar streetlights database 2019 (citizen audit)
sources.note: ~800 individually coded lamps, TWO-DATE PANEL 15 days apart. ok->dead transitions give an empirical fortnightly failure rate. Blank code + 'NEW SL REQD' rows are pole-without-lamp gap records. No coordinates.

sources.title: Streetlight counts per BBMP ward (198 wards)
sources.note: Divide by ward road length from OSM for the lamps-per-km prior. This is what makes the map non-empty on day zero.

sources.title: BBMP grievances 2025 (to 19 June)
sources.note: THE BASELINE. Filter Sub Category == 'Street Light Not Working'. Sorted by Grievance Date this IS the first-come queue the problem statement criticises. No coordinates, one date column only - do not claim resolution-time analysis.

sources.title: BBMP ward boundaries 2015 (198 wards) - USE THIS ONE
sources.note: The 198-ward vintage matches both streetlights_by_ward and the grievance ward names. Do NOT mix vintages - see docs/risks.md section 1.

sources.title: BBMP final wards map 2023 (243 wards)
sources.note: Different ward count. Reference only. Joining across vintages is a rabbit hole.

sources.title: BMTC GTFS (unofficial, scraped from Namma BMTC app)
sources.note: Maintainer warns timetables and stop timings are unreliable and only live-tracked routes are included. Use trip counts and service span, NOT scheduled arrival minutes.

sources.title: BMTC aggregated stops (carries trip_count per stop)
sources.note: trip_count is your night-service intensity signal without parsing stop_times.

sources.title: Bengaluru Traffic Police road safety report 2023
sources.note: VALIDATOR, not an input. Want: pedestrian fatalities day/night split, named blackspots. Manual extraction.

not_scripted.osm: See data/overpass.md. Run these FIRST - two load-bearing numbers depend on them.
not_scripted.google_places: Needs an API key. See docs/data-sources.md C2. The move is filtering opening_hours to close after 22:00.
not_scripted.worldpop_hrsl: Google Earth Engine catalog. Base layer only - residential population, not night activity.
not_scripted.viirs: NASA/VIIRS/002/VNP46A2 or NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG in Earth Engine. 500m pixels. Cannot resolve a street. Context layer only.
not_scripted.smartcities_mohua: Unauthenticated JSON API: https://smartcities.data.gov.in/backend/dmspublic/v1/resources?limit=100&offset=0&filters[domain_visibility]=777&query=street%20light -> total 93 streetlight resources, ~45 cities. ALL are the D24 indicator template (counts, LED vs conventional). No coordinates. File sizes 250B-133KB. One slide, not a data layer. See docs/national-data-landscape.md.
not_scripted.iudx: catalogue.cos.iudx.org.in dataset 9b27c09f-1ec6-4acd-89f0-a27f23184017 'Streetlights Location Info in Electronic City, Bengaluru' - pole coordinates + companion hourly current/voltage resource. Marked Private, needs Request Resource approval. Public sample record: {"deviceID":"L0302","location":{"type":"Point","coordinates":[77.666046,12.841758]}}. THIS IS OUR DATA CONTRACT - build to it.
not_scripted.datameet: https://github.com/datameet/Municipal_Spatial_Data/archive/master.zip - 5 cities, municipality boundary GeoJSON only, CC BY 4.0. No asset layers. Fallback for ward boundaries.
not_scripted.roboflow_exdark: Named in the Medium 'AI Dark Spot Auditor' blueprint: Roboflow Universe has pre-labelled night streetlight datasets (lit/unlit fixture heads, YOLO-ready); ExDark is the academic low-light image dataset. NOT in MVP scope - see docs/mvp.md 'what we deliberately do not build'.
